title: Crop Damage Assistance – Application for Input Subsidy

titles.hi: फसल नुकसान सहायता – इनपुट सब्सिडी हेतु आवेदन
titles.kn: ಬೆಳೆ ಹಾನಿ ನೆರವು – ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ

fields.help: Your full name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card or other identity proof.
fields.label: Full name of applicant

fields.help: Your father's name, or your husband's or wife's name if your records use that instead. Write it as it appears on your Aadhaar or land records.
fields.label: Father's / Spouse's name

fields.help: Your date of birth as printed on your Aadhaar card, in DD/MM/YYYY format.
fields.label: Date of birth

fields.help: Your 10-digit mobile number. Use the number linked to your bank account so you receive messages about the subsidy.
fields.label: Mobile number

fields.help: The identity document you will use as proof: Aadhaar or Driving Licence.
fields.label: Identity Proof
fields.help_query: identity document type Aadhaar or Driving Licence

fields.help: The number printed on the identity document you chose: 12 digits for Aadhaar, or the licence number for a Driving Licence.
fields.label: Identity document number

fields.help: Your full home address: house or plot number, street, and village or town, as on your Aadhaar.
fields.label: Residential address

fields.help: The district you live in, chosen from the list.
fields.label: District
fields.help_query: district taluk village as on RTC

fields.help: The taluk, the sub-division of your district, where you live. It is printed on your land record and address proof.
fields.label: Taluk
fields.help_query: district taluk village as on RTC

fields.help: The name of your village or town, as on your address proof or land record.
fields.label: Village
fields.help_query: district taluk village as on RTC

fields.help: The survey number (Sy. No.) of the land where the crop was damaged. You will find it on your RTC (Pahani) land record, and it looks like 45/2A.
fields.label: Land survey number (Sy. No.)
fields.help_query: survey number RTC Pahani where to find

fields.help: Only the area that was damaged, in acres, not all the land you own. Your RTC shows the extent, and 1 acre is 40 guntas.
fields.label: Extent of affected land (acres)
fields.help_query: extent of land acres guntas hectare

fields.help: The main crop that was damaged. Choose Other if yours is not in the list.
fields.label: Crop damaged

fields.help: The season of the damaged crop: Kharif is the monsoon crop (about June to October), Rabi is the winter crop (about October to March), and Summer is the hot-weather crop.
fields.label: Season

fields.help: The date the damage happened, or the day you first noticed it, in DD/MM/YYYY format.
fields.label: Date of damage
fields.help_query: date of damage intimate within 72 hours

fields.help: What caused the damage, for example heavy rain or flood, drought, hailstorm or pests. Choose the closest option.
fields.label: Cause of damage

fields.help: Your own estimate of how much of the crop was lost, as a percentage from 1 to 100. The official assessment may differ.
fields.label: Estimated crop loss (%)

fields.help: Your bank account number, 9 to 18 digits, printed in your passbook or on a cheque. The subsidy is paid into this account.
fields.label: Bank account number
fields.help_query: bank account number passbook Aadhaar seeded

fields.help: Your bank branch's 11-character IFSC code, like SBIN0001234. It is printed in your passbook and on your cheques.
fields.label: IFSC code
fields.help_query: IFSC code 11 character where to find

fields.help: The name of your bank and the branch, as printed in your passbook.
fields.label: Bank & branch name

fields.help: You confirm that everything you entered is true. Read it and tick the box yourself, because I will not tick it for you.
fields.label: I declare that the information given is true

labels.hi: मैं घोषणा करता/करती हूँ कि दी गई जानकारी सत्य है
